items.name: Order form / checkout copy
items.one_line: Words on the order page and cart that restate the offer, remove last doubts and reduce drop-off.
items.value_evidence: AWAI's 2026 pricing guide lists 'Order Page/Shopping Cart Sequence' as a project

sources.title: AWAI: 80 In-Demand Copywriting Projects (updated 2026-02-02)
sources.supports: copywriting pricing guide naming each project type with its own fee guideline; project names checked in the page HTML 2026-10-04

items.note: Overlaps UX microcopy; guarantee, trust badges and price restatement are the levers.

items.name: Packaging & label copy
items.one_line: On-pack words: name, claims, benefit line, usage, back-of-pack story, alongside mandatory declarations.
items.value_evidence: Usually written by brand agencies inside packaging design projects (no separate market list found)
items.note: India: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) and FSSAI labelling rules decide the mandatory panel; claims need substantiation.

items.name: Personal brand statement
items.one_line: One or two sentences stating who a person helps, how, and what makes them different, reused across profiles.
items.value_evidence: Sold inside LinkedIn and resume packages rather than alone.

sources.title: Fiverr Writing & Translation: LinkedIn Profiles
sources.supports: personal-branding copy sold with LinkedIn profiles

items.note: Feeds the LinkedIn headline, bio first line and portfolio header. Specific audience plus specific outcome beats adjectives.

items.name: Personal essay / creative nonfiction
items.one_line: A first-person nonfiction essay that turns a lived experience into an insight a stranger cares about.
items.value_evidence: Paid by some magazines and anthologies; small market. Op-eds and blog essays belong to the genre_content worker.

sources.title: Reedsy: Find Book Ghostwriting Services
sources.supports: marketplace guide prices: book proposal $750-$10,000 (59 projects, 2026); book ghostwriting average $450 per 1,000 words (2,006 offers, 2025); short-form $500-$2,000

sources.title: Fiverr: Articles & Blog Posts category (Article type facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Article type filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal (how many sellers offer it): Long-form article 3494, Informational 3483, Instructional/How-to 3138, News story 1738, Research article 1713, First-person narrative 1507, Listicle 1243, Review 679, Affiliate marketing 323, Opinion piece 280, Technical article 254

items.note: Scene first, reflection after; the insight must be earned by the story. Get consent or change details for real people who appear. [merged from genre:personal_essay_post: Literary/creative personal essays belong to genre_pro_creative; this card is the marketing/creator version (lesson-led, ends on a takeaway).]

items.name: Photo caption / cutline
items.one_line: One or two sentences under a news or editorial photo that identify who, what, where and when without repeating what the image shows.
items.value_evidence: Desk skill bundled into editing and photo-desk roles; no standalone freelance category found on 2026-10-04.
items.note: Present tense for the action, past tense for context; name people left to right. Social captions are genre:instagram_caption.

items.name: Pillar page
items.one_line: Broad hub page that covers a core topic at overview depth and links out to every detailed cluster article on that topic.
items.value_evidence: Bundled into SEO content-strategy retainers rather than sold alone; Fiverr's largest article type is long-form (3494 gigs on 2026-10-04).

sources.title: Fiverr: Articles & Blog Posts category (Article type facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Article type filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal (how many sellers offer it): Long-form article 3494, Informational 3483, Instructional/How-to 3138, News story 1738, Research article 1713, First-person narrative 1507, Listicle 1243, Review 679, Affiliate marketing 323, Opinion piece 280, Technical article 254

items.note: Shares shape with genre:ultimate_guide; the difference is its job as the internal-linking hub of a topic cluster.

items.name: Pinterest pin title + description
items.one_line: Keyword-rich title and description for a Pinterest pin that helps it surface in Pinterest search and earn the outbound click.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's social media copywriting Platform facet lists Pinterest (376 gigs on 2026-10-04), far below Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

sources.title: Fiverr: Social Media Copywriting category (Platform facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Platform filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal: Instagram 1910, Facebook 1663, LinkedIn 1338, TikTok 1009, Pinterest 376, Threads 238, Snapchat 123, Reddit 96, Twitter 47, Discord 5, Quora 3

items.note: Pinterest behaves like a search engine; write for search terms, not for a feed. Usually bundled with blog or affiliate work.

items.name: Podcast ad read / host-read talking points
items.one_line: Advertiser copy or talking points a podcast host turns into a personal endorsement.
items.value_evidence: Podcast networks and ad marketplaces publish advertiser guides for writing host-read scripts

sources.title: Gumball: How to write a host-read ad script (2022-08-18)
sources.supports: brands hand hosts talking points, with offer code and URL read twice

sources.title: Acast: How to write a podcast ad script
sources.supports: podcast network guidance for advertiser-written scripts

items.note: Talking points beat verbatim scripts except where legal wording is required; promo code and URL repeated.

items.name: Podcast script / episode outline
items.one_line: Run sheet for a podcast episode: cold open, intro, segments with talking points or full lines, ad breaks and outro.
items.value_evidence: Upwork's script writer type lists 'Podcast scripts and episode outlines' (Upwork, 2026-01-21); Fiverr's podcast-writing gigs list script writing, discussion guides and ad-break writing as deliverables (2026-10-04).

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

sources.title: Fiverr: Podcast Writing category (Service includes facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr podcast-writing gigs list deliverables: Episode summary 143, Segment timestamps 135, Relevant links 125, Script writing 114, Show notes 91, Discussion guide 80, Ad break 59 (gig counts, supply signal)

items.note: Interview shows want a question guide, not a word-for-word script; narrative shows want full scripts.

items.name: Podcast show notes
items.one_line: Episode page text: summary, key takeaways, timestamps, guest bio and links, written for listeners and for search.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's podcast-writing gigs list Episode summary (143), Segment timestamps (135) and Show notes (91) as deliverables on 2026-10-04, a small niche next to article writing.

sources.title: Fiverr: Podcast Writing category (Service includes facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr podcast-writing gigs list deliverables: Episode summary 143, Segment timestamps 135, Relevant links 125, Script writing 114, Show notes 91, Discussion guide 80, Ad break 59 (gig counts, supply signal)

items.note: Often produced from the transcript; check every timestamp against the final edit.

items.name: Poetry (free verse and formal)
items.one_line: Verse written for print, performance, greeting or occasion, in free verse or a set form.
items.value_evidence: Small paid market except occasional verse (weddings, greetings, brand poems) and spoken-word performance.

sources.title: Fiverr Writing & Translation: Creative Writing
sources.supports: creative-writing category exists on the Writing & Translation menu

items.note: Never paste existing poems as examples (copyright). Spoken-word pieces are written for breath and pause, not the page.

items.name: Policy brief
items.one_line: A short evidence-based document that recommends a policy action to a decision-maker.
items.value_evidence: Think tanks, NGOs and government advisory roles produce them; commissioned in research and advocacy projects.
items.note: Problem, evidence, options, recommendation, in a few pages. Lead with the recommendation. Cite data; separate fact from opinion.

items.name: Company policy / employee handbook
items.one_line: Internal rules and entitlements written so every employee understands what is expected and what they get.
items.value_evidence: Upwork lists employee handbooks and company policies among business-writing projects.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: business writer projects include employee handbooks and company policies

items.note: India: workplaces must have a POSH (sexual harassment) policy and Internal Committee under the 2013 Act; legal review before publishing. Plain language, numbered clauses, effective date and owner.

items.name: Political social-media commentary
items.one_line: Short opinion posts and threads reacting to political news, written to persuade or rally followers.
items.value_evidence: Party IT cells, political consultancies and political pages employ writers for it.
items.note: React fast but verify the news peg first. Name the claim, give the counter-fact with a source, end with a line people will repost. Election-period and defamation rules apply (compliance cards). Organic social formats as a whole belong to genre_content.

items.name: Political / rally speech
items.one_line: A speech for a leader or candidate at a rally, launch or legislature, built to rouse supporters and frame the opponent.
items.value_evidence: Parties and political consultancies employ speechwriters; BLS counts speechwriters within writers and authors.

sources.title: US BLS OOH: Writers and Authors
sources.supports: occupation includes speechwriters, novelists, playwrights, screenwriters and copywriters; median annual wage $76,910 (May 2025)

items.note: Indian rally speeches are mostly Hindi or regional language, call-and-response, slogans repeated, local issues named. Model Code of Conduct and hate-speech law apply during elections (compliance cards).

items.name: Portfolio case write-up (creative / design project)
items.one_line: A project story for a designer's or creative's portfolio: brief, constraints, process, decisions and result.
items.value_evidence: Written by the creative to win jobs; occasionally commissioned. Distinct from marketing case studies (genre_content worker).
items.note: Lead with the outcome and the role played. Show decisions and trade-offs, not just final frames. Credit collaborators; respect client NDAs and any contract rules on posting client work publicly.

items.name: Positioning statement / value proposition
items.one_line: One internal statement of who the product is for, what it is, and why it beats the alternative.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr Brand Voice & Tone lists 'Target audience & positioning' as a deliverable

sources.title: Fiverr: Brand Voice & Tone subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 371 gigs; deliverable filter = Brand narrative, Mission & vision statement, Voice & tone guidelines, Target audience & positioning, Business name & slogan, Brand design guidelines

items.note: Internal; the public lines (tagline, homepage hero) are written from it.

items.name: Post-purchase / review request email
items.one_line: Thank-you, how-to-use and review-request emails after an order that drive reviews and the second purchase.
items.value_evidence: Klaviyo lists the post-purchase flow among the first four to build; Fiverr Website Content lists 'Reviews' and 'Testimonials' as page types

sources.title: Klaviyo Help: Getting started with flows (updated 2026-03-30)
sources.supports: recommends building welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase and winback flows first; separate email and SMS welcome flows

sources.title: Fiverr: Website Content subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 4310 gigs; page-type filter = Landing page, Bio/About us, Homepage, Product page, Sales page, Generic content, FAQs, Contact us, Blog post, Privacy policy, Service page, Reviews, Testimonials, Terms & conditions, Press release

items.note: Review-request wording must not offer rewards for positive-only reviews (fake-review rules).

items.name: Product requirements document (PRD)
items.one_line: Defines the problem, users, goals and requirements of a product or feature so design and engineering can build it.
items.value_evidence: Written by product managers as part of the job rather than bought from freelancers; demand shows up as a skill in PM hiring, not as a marketplace category.
items.note: Typical parts: problem, goals and non-goals, users and use cases, requirements (must/should/could), success metrics, open questions, launch plan. Requirements must be testable.

items.name: Press kit / media kit
items.one_line: Pack of fact sheet, boilerplate, bios, key messages and FAQs that journalists use to cover a company.
items.value_evidence: Bundled with press-release work (Fiverr press release add-ons; no separate market list found)

sources.title: Fiverr: Press Releases subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 3627 gigs; add-ons Format press release, Submit press release, Research PR ideas

items.note: 'Media kit' also means an influencer's rate card; keep the two apart.
